claims.claim_text: The client receives from the server the following information about the world and the player’s state: Player Position, Player Speed, Collision, Opposite Lane Intersection, Sidewalk Intersection, Time, Player Acceleration, Player Orientation, Sensor readings, Non-Client-Controlled agents information, Traffic Lights information, Speed Limit Signs information.
claims.normalized_text: The client receives various state and environment information from the server including player position, speed, collisions, lane and sidewalk intersections, time, acceleration, orientation, sensor readings, other agents' info, traffic lights, and speed limit signs.
